notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Cars have long white plates with a maroon strip on the left; trucks have square black plates and police plates are blue.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The car is usually blurred, showing a left-side antenna and a white pickup. Rusty clips sit on the crossbar.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Mostly flat, arid sand with very few trees or plants.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Solid white edge lines with white or yellow centre lines; yellow edge lines are rare.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Round poles with three insulators, the middle one higher, and a crossbar braced by two diagonal bars.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons come as white on red and white on blue.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Pedestrian crossing signs show a man wearing a long robe.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Older coverage often shows banners for the 2022 football World Cup.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Nearly every main road is covered; the south and west have no coverage.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: The country is split into municipalities and numbered zones shown on street signs.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A very short antenna appears in the north.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A fairly long antenna appears in and around the capital.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A long antenna appears mostly in the southwest.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Four towers like a screw thread are visible from almost anywhere in Lusail.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: A hyperboloid tower, the tallest building in the country, can be seen across the Baaya district.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Education City has black-tiled roads and ground-mounted brown street signs.
